information_flow: The first call receives every common input, adjudicates their relevance under the counter-hypothesis, and emits one authoritative policy-free analysis. The final call consumes only that analysis, cannot reacquire external evidence, and emits one policy.
name: Evidence-Closed Delegation
organization: two-call sequential lineage with one common-evidence intake followed by a completely evidence-closed policy authority

calls.objective: Assess all supplied sources, settle their admissibility under the counter-hypothesis, preserve consequential tensions, and emit one authoritative policy-free analysis sufficient for downstream action.
Consume commit_counter_evidence as the sole visible evidence, preserve its settled exclusions without reopening external sources, and emit one complete policy.
